affix.note: Prefix and suffix icons via inputs. The built-in visibility toggle is already a suffix action; custom interactive content uses the same slot with both [solaris-form-suffix] and [solaris-form-suffix-action].

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

password-field.description: Form Field preset for passwords with built-in visibility toggle, policy validation, requirements list, and strength indicator. Composes Form Field + Input.

examples.note: Basic password field with autocomplete for the login context.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the password field component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius is delegated to the inner Form Field: md maps to 8px and lg renders as a pill.

requirements.note: Provide a policy with [showRequirements] for the checklist and [showStrength] for the heuristic meter. minLength and maxLength fold into the effective policy. Works with Reactive Forms through ControlValueAccessor and solarisPasswordValidator.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: the inner Form Field owns the outer height while the preset keeps font and padding in sync. The toggle icon scales with the same matrix.

states.note: Disabled and readonly are real, not visual-only. Loading renders a spinner overlay in the suffix slot without shifting the layout.

password-field.title: Password Field

toggle.note: The built-in toggle is a suffix action: no divider, action variant, and an icon sized by the 9-combo size x density matrix. Hide it with [showToggle]="false" and bind [visible] for a controlled field.
